meta.name: remove-deadcode
meta.description: Remove unused code from this project with ultrawork mode, LSP-verified safety, atomic commits. Triggers: remove dead code, dead code, cleanup, remove unused.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把项目里没人调用的代码安全删掉,并留下可回退的提交记录。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果项目里堆积了越来越多没人再调用的旧代码,想干净利落地清掉。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if old unused code keeps piling up in your project and you want it gone safely.

howto.what: Claude 会扫描项目里没人引用的代码——未使用的导入、函数、参数、类型和孤立文件,用 LSP 引用检查确认后再删,删除工作交给并行子代理分批执行,每批通过类型检查后单独提交一次 commit,最后给出移除清单和验证结果。
howto.when: 当你说「remove dead code」「dead code」「cleanup」等关键词时触发;也可以指定文件、目录或符号名来缩小扫描范围,不给参数则扫描整个项目。

say.text: 帮我清理这个项目里没人用的代码
say.note: 先扫描,再用 LSP 引用检查核实后删除

say.text: 只扫描 src/utils 目录下的 dead code
say.note: 把扫描范围缩小到该目录

say.text: 把 unusedFunc 这个没用到的函数清掉

howto.what_en: Claude scans for unreferenced code (unused imports, functions, parameters, types, files), verifies each with an LSP reference check, then hands deletions to parallel sub-agents. Batches are typechecked, committed separately, then summarized.
howto.when_en: Triggers on keywords like "dead code", "cleanup", or "remove unused". You can name a file, directory, or symbol to narrow the scan; with no argument it scans the whole project.

say_en.text: Clean up the unused code in this project.
say_en.note: Scans first, then verifies with LSP

say_en.text: Only scan the src/utils directory for dead code.
say_en.note: Narrows the scan to that directory
